Needs changes before merge. One P3 finding requires `needs-rework`.

I read the whole diff against the current upstream laws. The local trial merge uses upstream/main `d4601c6ea11653041a2c78352c46c4e1cd177513`. Its first parent is the PR head above. This is a safety-tier review because the stacked holder changes affect geometry used by collision checks.

Requested before merge:

1. **[P3] Check the stored tool for the Apply holder refusal.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tool_library_dialog/model.rs:165` checks `k.tool`, which is the unapplied tool draft. `assembly_group.rs:76` presents its error as the refusal of Apply holder. However, `SetToolBody::library` checks the stored tool. Keep the stored flute length at 15 mm. Change the draft flute length to 5 mm without Apply. Choose ER20 chuck and set projection to 10 mm. The preview accepts the draft and shows no refusal. Apply holder refuses because the holder reaches into the stored tool's flutes. The reverse occurs with draft flutes of 25 mm and projection of 20 mm. The message says Apply holder refuses, but the command accepts the stored tool with 15 mm flutes. Compute the command refusal from `editor_stored_tool()`. Keep the draft preview diagnostic separate. Add tests for both directions. This is a code-path finding; the existing tests do not cover unapplied flute edits. It is also the unresolved finding in [the parent PR review](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/3931#issuecomment-7145072048). The affected code is unchanged here.

What looks good:

- Suggest and Copy fill the separate window draft. Apply and undo use the existing commands.
